prompt:
CONCEPT: a female personification of Lu Xun (육손), a strategist of Eastern Wu in the Romance of the Three Kingdoms — the young scholar-general whose fire at Yiling ended Shu's advance. Reimagined as a woman; her costume, ornaments, colours and bearing carry her famous deeds and temperament. This is a character design, not a historical portrait.
STYLE: Premium Korean MMORPG promotional character render — an in-engine 3D character model with hand-painted textures, not flat cel shading and not a 2D anime illustration: semi-realistic volumetric forms, porcelain skin with a soft subsurface glow and glossy specular highlights, a small refined face with delicate realistic-anime features, long legs and a narrow waist on a full, curvaceous figure — soft, rounded volume at bust, hips and thighs in the body type SILHOUETTE names; never thin, flat or boyishly straight. Polished metal, silk and gems catch sharp highlights. Extremely intricate ornamented costume — filigree metalwork, jewel inlays, layered translucent fabrics and fine embroidery. Character-select-screen lighting: strong rim light, soft key light on the face, drifting light particles, atmospheric depth with a softly blurred background. Luxurious, high-detail finish.
TRAITS of Lu Xun to carry in her design and the scene: calm genius and patience, scholar's robes over light armor, flames reflected in her eyes.
FACTION — Eastern Wu. Palette: crimson red, gold, river teal, black lacquer.
AGE: mid-twenties — a clear adult face; no facial lines.
SILHOUETTE: slender-limbed yet full-busted with rounded hips and a narrow waist build; short cropped hair with side-swept bangs; polished copper-red hair.
FACE — she must read as her own person at a glance, NOT the style's default pretty face and not a sister of the other characters: first impression — a cool, aloof beauty; fair skin; diamond-shaped face; moderately sized, realistically proportioned eyes — large round eyes, outer eye corners tilting sharply upward; thin arched brows; small button nose; wide smiling mouth; gold eyes; sharp winged eyeliner.
WORLD — MEDIEVAL FANTASY: a river-and-sea kingdom of medieval high fantasy: a vast river delta, crimson-sailed galleons and war galleys, harbor fortresses of red stone, fire magic dancing over dark water. COSTUME (medieval fantasy): an archmage-strategist's robes — layered robes with runic embroidery, a high collar, a circlet, a staff or a grimoire, star-chart motifs. Western medieval high-fantasy dress — plate, mail and heraldic tabards, gowns and mantles, circlets and crowns; steel, leather, wool, velvet and gold, subtle magical glow along the patterns. Her Three Kingdoms origin shows only through her signature item, her colours and her bearing — her outfit is Western: no wrap-collar robes, no wide hanfu sleeves, no flowing Chinese-style robe over armor, no East-Asian armor, no machinery, no modern material. The setting is Western European medieval — stone castles, Romanesque or Gothic architecture, European mountains, forests and towns; no Chinese architecture, no pagodas or curved tiled roofs, no hanzi on banners. LIGHT: natural daylight or the world's own magical glow, unless TIME & WEATHER says otherwise. Celestial ornament: feather-and-gold wing-shaped ornaments at the shoulders or back, a translucent gauze overskirt, a jewelled circlet.
MOOD: serene celestial key art — pastel sky light, a soft halo of light behind her, floating golden light particles and drifting feathers.
EXPOSURE (bold): her regalia opens to show skin — bare shoulders and arms between pauldron and bracer, a deep open neckline under the gorget with natural cleavage, a high slit in the tabard or gown showing the thigh; armor pieces stay on and symmetrical. Nothing slipped off. Chest and pelvis covered; no corset; keep the costume WORLD describes, material and palette.
OUTPUT: one character image that works as card art. Vertical 2:3 frame, full body with head and feet inside the frame with clear margins, face turned toward the camera (front or three-quarter). Standing, card-ready pose; the environment may be rich while her design stays fully readable.
SIGNATURE ITEM: a white-feathered fan with a flame motif — she holds or carries it, drawn at full scale, in the form this WORLD gives it. It is one whole object drawn once: a long weapon (spear, glaive, halberd, staff, bow) keeps a single straight, unbroken shaft from butt to head with exactly one head or blade, held in front of or beside her body — never passing behind her head or shoulders, never broken, bent, split in two by her body or arm, or duplicated; if the frame cuts it, it leaves the frame as one straight line.
EXPRESSION: relaxed brow, softly open eyes, lips closed and unstrained, no smile.
BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose or the frame.
ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no horse or other creature, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border. No readable text or numbers — banners and shields carry only heraldic devices (a beast or a crest), never letters or Chinese characters.
ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, both hands drawn correctly as hands. No extra limbs.

observations: 1024×1536 one adult woman, full head and both boots inside frame; two coherent arms and hands. Right hand holds a single white flame-feather fan.
Western fantasy bodice, metal pauldrons, jeweled belt, cape and stone castle river city; no Hanfu or Japanese clothing, no text or watermark.
Hair is a short copper crop, distinct from the samguk bob, but selected large round eyes and diamond facial outline are weakly expressed; the face still resembles the other world.
qa.cause: Generated result differs from the selected framing, pose, or costume; retained under IMAGE_AUTOMATION.md section 0 for user review.
